decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Flood Risk Assessment, Planning Statement, Heritage Statement, 3012/101A, 102, 103, 104, MO1A, 201A, 202A, 203A, 204, Received 3 November 2010, Email from Nick Davey, Received 20 December 2010, Email from Nick Davey, Received 22 December 2010  and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 4 - The restaurant and public house premises shall close, and all customers shall have left the premises for the night, by midnight Sunday to Thursday and 12.30am Friday and Saturday.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority. The flat roof shall only be used in the case of an emergency as a fire exit.
Condition : 6 - The scheme of extract ventilation shown on the approved drawings shall be carried out before any part of the development hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - The access doorway to the entrance from Thames Road shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Replacement of part of the rear ground floor of the public house with a single storey rear extension with a glazed canopy area and alterations to the rear car park and rear external areas.
